scripts.build: bun --bun vite build && bun run scripts/prerender.js && bun run scripts/post-build.js
scripts.bundle: bun run build && bun run embed
scripts.compile: bun run bundle && bun build ./server.js --compile --minify --outfile trypinn
scripts.compile:linux-x64: bun run bundle && bun build ./server.js --compile --minify --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile trypinn-linux-x64
scripts.compile:linux-arm64: bun run bundle && bun build ./server.js --compile --minify --target=bun-linux-arm64 --outfile trypinn-linux-arm64
scripts.compile:darwin-x64: bun run bundle && bun build ./server.js --compile --minify --target=bun-darwin-x64 --outfile trypinn-darwin-x64
scripts.compile:darwin-arm64: bun run bundle && bun build ./server.js --compile --minify --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile trypinn-darwin-arm64
scripts.compile:windows-x64: bun run bundle && bun build ./server.js --compile --minify --target=bun-windows-x64 --outfile trypinn-windows-x64.exe
scripts.compile:all: bun run compile:linux-x64 && bun run compile:linux-arm64 && bun run compile:darwin-x64 && bun run compile:darwin-arm64 && bun run compile:windows-x64
